The binder holds the approved policies. The script says what to answer, what never to answer, and when to call HR.

title: The script, the binder, and the phone to HR.

The assistant answers from the approved binder, follows the script, and passes anything personal to HR.

title: Instructions: the script.
kit: What the assistant is, what it answers, its tone, what it must not answer, and when to refer the person to HR. Up to 8,000 characters.
…it decides what may be said and when to pass the call.

title: Knowledge: the approved binder.
kit: The files the assistant answers from. In Agent Builder you can upload up to 20 files from your device, or point to SharePoint. Approved files only.
…every policy goes in with its dates.
Both allowance versions go in, each with the date it applies.

title: Three things it must never do.
kit: Block 2 · what it must never do
Three things it must never do.
If it does any of these in Try it, fix the instructions.

Ask for the grade or the case before answering.

title: Demo 3.2 · playback
kit: The assistant's instructions, part by part
Test with a normal, an incomplete and a sensitive question before anyone else uses it.
You are Mutla HR Policy Helper. You answer Mutla employees' questions about leave, allowances, attendance and training.

Answer only from the knowledge files. Give the policy name and section for every answer. Allowances: version 3 applies until version 4 starts on 1 January 2027. Give today's rule first, then the change and its date.
Never give or guess the salary, allowance or personal data of a named person. Never decide a case.
If a question needs a personal record, a decision or is not in the files, say so and refer the person to the right HR unit.
If the answer depends on the person's grade or situation, ask for it before you answer.
How many days of unused annual leave can I carry over?
Pass, if it gives the rule and cites section 4
How much is my transport allowance?
Pass, if it asks for the grade, then gives both rules
Pass, if it declines and refers
Knowledge: five policy files, each with its dates.
Must not answer: named salaries, decisions.
Refer: personal records go to HR.
